judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A moody, layered sky with impressive depth but held back by dull colors and a cluttered foreground.
strengths: strong sense of depth and layering
dramatic dark cloud base suggests storm
good tonal range from bright to dark
weaknesses: lacks vibrant color or striking light
composition is somewhat cluttered at the bottom
overall mood is gloomy rather than beautiful
